newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 6.677 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 6.677 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 98-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.677 percent versus 6.778 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 189-day treasury bills was 6.713 percent versus 6.820 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for the NZ$50 million of 378-day treasury bills offered for and accepted was 7.007 percent versus 7.085 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
